latestVersion.changelog:
Image to Free — Initial Release

- Launches the "Image to Free" tool for turning photos into free downloadable video clips, with cloud GPU processing.
- Supports drag-and-drop image uploads and plain text instructions for quick MP4 video creation (no timeline editing needed).
- Offers anonymous sign-up for 100 free credits; session and export management handled automatically.
- Integrates with API for uploading, editing, credits checking, project state, and exporting up to 1080p MP4 (and other formats).
- Includes user-friendly prompts and clear guidance for common actions (upload, export, credits, status).
- Handles error codes with concise user feedback (token expire, file errors, limit reached, etc.).
